selection_method: Exact public Git tree paths selected from path metadata before fetching or inspecting either response body. No content-based reselection, deletion, or outcome-based exclusion is permitted.

selected_fresh_capture_paths.selection_reason: A versioned PyPI target in a public provider fixture, absent from all existing FALSUM frozen source rosters.
A versioned npm target and version distinct from FALSUM's frozen lodash 4.17.15 captures, absent from all existing FALSUM frozen source rosters.

prior_roster_exclusion_rule: Reject any selected path present in data/phase5ab-original-receipt-comparability-lock.json, data/phase5x-frozen-original-three-provider-lodash-relevance.json, data/phase5y-original-reviewed-lodash-six-advisory-protocol.json, data/phase5z-frozen-app-consumption-protocol.json, or the Phase 5AG reviewed-source roster.

independent_reference_source.source_selection: For each identifier actually emitted by a selected response, resolve only its canonical GHSA record or declared CVE alias at this frozen commit. Missing, ambiguous, withdrawn, malformed, or unsupported source data is INSUFFICIENT/UNKNOWN; it cannot be converted into a positive label.

evaluation_contract.target_binding: Use only the exact ecosystem, package and version in each selected request envelope. Do not infer target identity from path names or caller classifications.
evaluation_contract.falsum_policy: Authenticated source identity, exact package match, and a fail-closed introduced/fixed/last_affected interval evaluator. Display-only applicability; never security clearance.
evaluation_contract.competent_baseline: An independently implemented version-aware interval baseline using the same authenticated source records, exact package/ecosystem binding, numeric version comparison, exclusive fixed and inclusive last_affected boundaries, and explicit abstention on unsupported ranges. It is not accept-all and is not FALSUM code reuse.
evaluation_contract.comparison_unit: One response-reference assertion, plus per-capture aggregate counts. Duplicate identifiers are counted once per capture and separately reported as malformed/repeated input.
evaluation_contract.success_or_failure_rule: Report exact agreement, disagreement and abstention. Do not treat agreement with the competent baseline as a new improvement; a meaningful delta must be independently explained and source-bound.
